tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The board itself: the infinite canvas behind every card. Never put body text directly on it except hints in `label-3`.

tokens.name: canvas-lift
tokens.usage: Raised regions of the board: stage bays and lane backgrounds.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card faces, the open-card sheet (Margin) and solid menus. Primary text ground.

tokens.name: card-2
tokens.usage: Inset wells inside a card: link URLs, file paths, audio bars, segmented controls.

tokens.name: card-3
tokens.usage: Deepest inset and pressed wells inside a card.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `card`, `card-2`, `canvas` and `chrome`. Card titles, button labels.

tokens.name: label-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `card` and `chrome`: card body copy, idle tool icons, tooltips.

tokens.name: label-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on `card`, `card-2`, `card-3` and `canvas`: card kind line, timestamps, meta, eyebrows, kanban “+ Add…”, audio timecodes. Passes 4.5:1 on every surface in both themes. Dark is .52, raised on 2026-11-17 from .48, which failed on inset wells (4.4:1 on `card-2`, 4.2:1 on `card-3`). Lumen matches since `main@285e8f6`.

tokens.name: label-4
tokens.usage: Disabled glyphs (an empty composer's send arrow). Not for readable text.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairline borders: inset rings on wells and segmented controls.

tokens.name: hair-2
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: chip rings, evidence-weight rings, mode chips.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: Wires between cards on the board (lineage links).

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons, menu rows and tool buttons; also the secondary button fill.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for ghost buttons and menu rows.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Floating glass UI over the board: composer, tool rail, toasts, menus, tooltips, review pill. Always with backdrop blur.

tokens.name: chrome-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `chrome` surfaces when `label` is not used.

tokens.name: act
tokens.usage: Primary action fill — the one decisive button (Send, Apply). Inverts per theme.

tokens.name: on-act
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `act`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Selection marquee and focus treatments on the board.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and Stop actions: Delete, Stop, the “suggests deleting” tint, struck words in a diff. Used as a 12–14% tint (with `danger-ink` for the words on it) and as a solid fill on hover. Light `#e12f34` is 4.5:1 on `card`, and white on it (the solid hover fill) is also 4.5:1. Deepened on 2026-11-17 from `#e5484d` (3.9:1). Lumen matches since `main@285e8f6`. Dark `#ff6369` is unchanged.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Red text that sits on a red tint or on translucent chrome: Stop, Delete in menus, struck words in a proposal diff, the “suggests deleting” line. Light `#b02529`: at least 4.7:1 on a 14% `danger` tint over `card`, `card-2` or `canvas`, and 6.7:1 on `card`. Dark `#ff797e`: 5.5:1 on a 14% tint over `card`. Use `danger` for fills and marks, `danger-ink` for words.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success as text: connected, accepted, done. Leaf green (hue 95°), kept clearly apart from lineage `C` (hue 155°) so success never reads as “direction C” (ΔE 30). Light `#3c7811` is 5.4:1 on `card`, 5.0:1 on `card-2` and 4.6:1 on `canvas`; dark `#6cc23a` is 7.6:1 on `card`. Changed on 2026-11-17 from `#247a50` / `#30a46c`, which were ΔE 3.6 from `C`. Use `ok-fill` for shapes.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution states: the crew-on-built-in-rules dot in crew settings, and the “card changed since this was suggested” line on a proposal. Used on `card`, `canvas` and `chrome`. Light `#886600` is ochre (hue 45°), kept clearly apart from lineage `A` amber (hue 34°) so caution never reads as “direction A”. It is 5.3:1 on `card`, 4.9:1 on `card-2` and 4.5:1 on `canvas`. Dark `#d97706`: 5.3:1 on `card`, 6.4:1 on `canvas`. Lumen used to have only a fallback (`#d97706`); the token is defined in both themes since `main@285e8f6`. Light was changed on 2026-11-17 for contrast and to separate it from `A`.

tokens.name: ok-fill
tokens.usage: `ok` as a pure shape: the on-state of a Switch, connected dots, done rings and badges. Light `#4c9816` is 3.6:1 on `card` and 3.1:1 on `canvas`, light enough not to look heavy. Never put text on it. Dark matches `ok`.

tokens.name: warn-fill
tokens.usage: `warn` as a filled mark: caution dots, stale wires. Light `#ab8209` is 3.5:1 on `card` and 3.0:1 on `canvas`. `warn` itself is the text-safe ink. Dark matches `warn`.

tokens.name: A
tokens.usage: Lineage A — the first direction in a fork. Wires, chips, adopted rings, Reported evidence, Wright's progress, the first kanban column. Light is `#9f5a00`: 5.3:1 on `card`, 4.9:1 on `card-2` and 4.6:1 on `canvas`, so it's usable as text. Deepened on 2026-11-17 from `#db7c00` (3.0:1). Lumen matches since `main@285e8f6`.

tokens.name: B
tokens.usage: Lineage B — the second direction. Also Proposal evidence, search hits and the Search mode. Light is `#2066db`: 5.3:1 on `card`, 4.9:1 on `card-2` and 4.5:1 on `canvas`, so it's usable as small text on all three. Deepened on 2026-11-17 from `#2b6fe0`, which failed on `card-2` (4.4:1) and `canvas` (4.0:1). Lumen matches since `main@285e8f6`.

tokens.name: C
tokens.usage: Lineage C — the third direction. Also Observed evidence, the Locked kanban column and live status dots. Light is `#0b7b50`: 5.3:1 on `card`, 4.9:1 on `card-2` and 4.5:1 on `canvas`, so it's usable as text. Deepened on 2026-11-17 from `#0e9662` (3.8:1). Lumen matches since `main@285e8f6`.

tokens.name: D
tokens.usage: Lineage D — the fourth direction. Wires, chip, adopted ring, error dot. Light is `#ca2760`: 5.3:1 on `card`, 4.9:1 on `card-2` and 4.5:1 on `canvas`, so it's usable as text, matching A, B and C. Deepened on 2026-11-17 from `#d93b72` (4.4:1). Lumen matches since `main@285e8f6`.

tokens.name: A-fill
tokens.usage: Lineage A as a filled mark: evidence blocks, bars, dots, large fills. Lumen amber, nudged to pass 3:1 on canvas; at least 3:1 on card, card-2 and canvas. `A` itself is the text-safe ink (4.5:1); never use `A` for a fill or `A-fill` for text. Dark matches `A`.

tokens.name: B-fill
tokens.usage: Lineage B as a filled mark: evidence blocks, bars, dots, large fills. Lumen’s original blue; at least 3:1 on card, card-2 and canvas. `B` itself is the text-safe ink (4.5:1); never use `B` for a fill or `B-fill` for text. Dark matches `B`.

tokens.name: C-fill
tokens.usage: Lineage C as a filled mark: evidence blocks, bars, dots, large fills. Lumen’s original green; at least 3:1 on card, card-2 and canvas. `C` itself is the text-safe ink (4.5:1); never use `C` for a fill or `C-fill` for text. Dark matches `C`.

tokens.name: D-fill
tokens.usage: Lineage D as a filled mark: evidence blocks, bars, dots, large fills. Lumen’s original rose; at least 3:1 on card, card-2 and canvas. `D` itself is the text-safe ink (4.5:1); never use `D` for a fill or `D-fill` for text. Dark matches `D`.

tokens.name: chip-ink
tokens.usage: Letter on a lineage chip (A–D) — white in light, near-black in dark. White passes on every light chip at 5.3:1.

tokens.name: light
tokens.usage: 'Light is alive': the glow colour of working crew, live drafts and the review pulse dot.

tokens.name: bloom
tokens.usage: Warm glow around something the crew is working on or waiting on you for. Only as a soft shadow, never a fill.

tokens.name: crew-scout
tokens.usage: Scout's ink (reads sources, weighs evidence). Avatar glyph and its tooltip icon.

tokens.name: crew-strategist
tokens.usage: Strategist's ink (forks a claim into testable directions).

tokens.name: crew-wright
tokens.usage: Wright's ink (builds proofs: pages, decks, action lists).

tokens.name: crew-critic
tokens.usage: Critic's ink (checks work against its sources).

tokens.name: orb-off
tokens.usage: An idle crew avatar's fill: unlit until that crew member is working.

tokens.name: note-butter
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper (butter tone, the default). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: note-ink
tokens.usage: The 6px dot in a sticky's tag, on `note-butter`. `#925600` reaches 4.52:1 on the paper, so it can also carry small text. Sticky body text is near-black ink at 88%. Same in both themes, like the paper. Deepened on 2026-11-17 from `#9a5b00` (4.15:1). Lumen matches since `main@285e8f6`.

families.ui: "Inter Var", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Noto Sans SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Lumen Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Snapshot edition number (“No. 1”). The one display size; tabular numerals.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page and dialog headings, empty-state titles. The step between cards and display.

styles.name: direction-title
styles.usage: Title of a Direction card (a lettered A–D proposal).

styles.name: idea-title
styles.sample: Players read faction shifts in under 1.2s
styles.usage: The claim on an Idea / Core Thesis card, and Question cards.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Title of Source, Recording, Link, Notepad, Group and most other cards.

styles.name: note-text
styles.sample: Constraint: glyph must hold legibility in heavy rain.
styles.usage: Handwritten-feel text on a sticky note.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Design pillar: zero pause-screen menu fatigue.
styles.usage: Long reading: Margin sheet body, notepad text, onboarding copy.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Card body copy and default UI text.

styles.name: toast
styles.sample: Locked: only you can change this card.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, menu commands, review pill.

styles.name: card-kind
styles.usage: The kind line at the top of every card, in `label-3`.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Card footers and timestamps, tabular numerals, in `label-3`.

styles.name: weight
styles.usage: Evidence-weight pill text. 12px because it carries meaning.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest readable text: media badges, counts in pills, kbd hints. Latin only; Chinese floors at 12px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase panel captions (minimap). The only uppercase style.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: The letter inside a lineage chip. The one size below 11px, because it is a single glyph.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: URLs on link cards, elapsed time.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between segmented-control buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between tool-rail buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default inline gap: icon to label, chips in a row, tool-rail padding, media inset inside a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked composer parts and floating UI.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Menu row and toast inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card footer top spacing; header control padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen gutter for all floating chrome; card top padding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Card inline padding (16px 18px 17px).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a group.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Margin sheet and dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section gaps in sheets, dialogs and docs.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Media timecodes, kbd hints, kanban items, lock badge, small wells.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Lineage chip (18px square).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons (28–32px), action-strip buttons, link wells, kanban columns, selection marquee.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Project switcher, tooltips, segmented controls, proposal bars.

tokens.name: radius-media
tokens.usage: Images and video inside a card (6px inset); menus, toasts and the draft bar.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: 44px square controls: Send, Add, Mic; review popover.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card on the board.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Composer field.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Open-card sheet (Margin) and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: tool rail, review pill, evidence weight, mode chip, zoom control.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting card on the board.

tokens.name: shadow-card-up
tokens.usage: Hovered or dragged card; the open-card sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-chrome
tokens.usage: Floating glass chrome: composer, tool rail, toasts, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-field-focus
tokens.usage: Focus on a text field: the field turns `card` and this soft warm glow surrounds it, instead of a grey ring. The same warm light the crew uses for "alive". Buttons and other controls keep the `focus` ring.

size.note: Control heights. Every interactive control snaps to one of these; small visuals keep a 24px+ hit area.

tokens.name: size-xs
tokens.usage: Pills that are labels, not buttons: evidence weight, media badges, counts.

tokens.name: size-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons: draft bar, toast actions, segmented control, proposal actions, menu rows on dense surfaces.

tokens.name: size-md
tokens.usage: Default button and menu row.

tokens.name: size-lg
tokens.usage: Tool rail, composer controls, crew seats, crew settings.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Touch-first and primary hero controls.

icon.note: Icon box sizes. Strokes stay 1.65 (2 at 12px and below).

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Inside pills, kind lines, compact buttons.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Menus, default buttons, segmented controls.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default UI icon, tool rail.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Composer controls, empty states.

duration.note: Motion timing. Under prefers-reduced-motion, transitions drop to 0 and loops stop.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Press scale feedback.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, colour and opacity changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Small layout changes, menus and popovers opening.

tokens.name: duration-spring
tokens.usage: Snappy spring: chips and pills appearing.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Smooth spring: sheets and large layout shifts.

easing.note: Curves. Springs are linear() curves in the app; this is the standard ease for everything else.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Default ease-out for transitions.

zIndex.note: Stacking layers above the board. Use these, not raw numbers.

tokens.name: z-card
tokens.usage: Cards on the board.

tokens.name: z-wire
tokens.usage: Ports and wire handles above cards.

tokens.name: z-chrome
tokens.usage: Floating chrome: tool rail, composer, minimap, top bar.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the Margin sheet.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and the open Task Island.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, always on top.

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width on every interactive element.

tokens.name: ring-offset
